sentences: VALU writes and exports are masked by it, scalar ops aren't, and `v_cmpx`, saveexec and EXEC writes update it.
A pixel lane still inactive at the end is discarded.

Measured on native gfx1100 (8 threads): a `v_mov_b32` under `EXEC=0x0F` leaves the other lanes untouched, `EXEC=0` writes nothing, a store writes only active lanes and `v_cmpx_gt_u32` narrows EXEC (4 of 4 cases); note that AMD clang 20 rejects `v_add_co_u32`, `v_sub_co_u32`, `v_add_co_ci_u32` and `v_mad_u64_u32` for `gfx1100`, `gfx1101` and `gfx1102`, so this toolchain could not reproduce the RX 7600 result below, which leaves open whether those parts support the opcodes and says only that they could not be assembled here.

A pixel lane that was inactive at the last `exp ... vm` it executed is discarded, and on a path without one, a lane inactive at the end (EXEC is kept at the export only where a path can write it afterwards).

**The `vm` rule is from the RDNA2 ISA reference guide (30-November-2020, §11.1 and §11.2.1: EXEC at the export is the valid mask and the final one sent is used), not measured on hardware**; checked on the CPU by `tests/semantic/test_export_valid_mask.py`.

VALU scalar lane-mask destinations (`v_cmp_*`, `v_add_co_u32`, `v_add_co_ci_u32`, `v_sub_co_u32`, `v_sub_co_ci_u32`, `v_subrev_co_u32`, `v_subrev_co_ci_u32`, `v_mad_u64_u32`, `v_mad_i64_i32`) write 0 for lanes off in EXEC (`SDST[lane] = EXEC[lane] ? bit : 0`, AMD RDNA2 ISA).

Until 2026-11-22 the six `*_co_*` ops and `v_mad_u64_u32`/`v_mad_i64_i32` did not AND the carry/sign bit with `active`, so inactive lanes leaked 1 bits into `VCC`/SGPR masks (`s_bcnt1`, `s_cbranch_vccz`, `v_cndmask_b32`).

Checked on the CPU by `tests/semantic/test_carry_exec_mask.py` (wave32, wave64, and `--wave64-emulate` structure), and GPU-verified on native RDNA2 (gfx1036, AMD Radeon Graphics) with partial EXEC masks (inactive lanes write 0 in sdst for `v_add_co_u32` and `v_mad_u64_u32`).

Checked on the CPU by `tests/semantic/test_carry_exec_mask.py` (wave32, wave64, and `--wave64-emulate` structure), and **hardware-verified on an AMD RX 7600 (gfx1102)** with `v_add_co_u32` and `v_add_co_ci_u32` carrying on every active lane: VCC reads `0xffffffff` with full EXEC, `0x0000ffff` for the mask `0x0000ffff` and `0xaaaaaaaa` for `0xaaaaaaaa` in wave32, `vcc_lo = 0x0000ffff` with `vcc_hi = 0x0000000f` for the same partial mask in wave64, and `0` when EXEC is 0 even with VCC preloaded to all ones; with one carrying lane under mask `0x0000ffff` VCC is `0x00000001`, and `v_sub_co_u32`/`v_subrev_co_u32` with a borrow under that mask give `0x0000ffff` too.

The `*_co_ci_` forms, `v_mad_u64_u32` and `v_mad_i64_i32` share the same path but were not measured separately.; also GPU-verified on native RDNA2 (gfx1036, AMD Radeon Graphics) with partial EXEC masks (inactive lanes write 0 in sdst for `v_add_co_u32` and `v_mad_u64_u32`).
